lines.text: After a nap, I feel good as new.

data.define: Used when something or someone is completely fixed or healthy.

example.text: After a nap, I feel good as new.

misuse.text: Don't call a broken phone 'good as new'.
misuse.why: It means fully repaired or healed.

data.l1_hook: Ngủ một giấc là khỏe liền!
data.l1_ex: Ngủ một giấc xong, tui thấy good as new.

native.tip: “good as new” = Khỏe như mới. Ví dụ: “After a nap, I feel good as new.”
native.caption:
“good as new” nghĩa là gì?

Ví dụ: “After a nap, I feel good as new.” (Ngủ một giấc xong, tui thấy good as new.)
